title: VTC Events — Check-in — Ticket Session — Start — payload
description: An event's door staff open an OpenID4VP 1.0 presentation session asking for that event's ticket, so a registrant's wallet can present it at the door (VTI-EVT-173). The door staff member is the document proof's signer. The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

occurrence.description: On a series registered by occurrence: the occurrence the door is for, by its original start (VTI-EVT-194, 195). Refused on an event that is not a series.

clientIdPrefix.description: The OpenID4VP 1.0 client identifier prefix the community should identify itself to the wallet with — a DID (`decentralized_identifier`) or an X.509 certificate (`x509_hash`). Values are OpenID4VP's own and are carried verbatim. Absent: the community's default.

TicketSessionId.description: Opaque, unguessable identifier of a door session, carrying at least 128 bits of entropy, base64url without padding.

Response.title: VTC Events — Check-in — Ticket Session — Start — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/events/checkin/ticket-session/start/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/events/checkin/ticket-session/start/0.1#response.

occurrence.description: The occurrence the session is for, where the event is a series (VTI-EVT-195).

walletUri.description: The OpenID4VP invocation URI for this session, carrying `client_id` and `request_uri`, for the door to show as a QR code. Its scheme is the community's choice for the wallet ecosystem it serves — `openid4vp://`, `haip-vp://` and other OpenID4VP invocation schemes.

clientId.description: The full OpenID4VP client identifier the community presents to the wallet, prefix included. It is the audience the wallet's key-binding proof names.

expiresAt.description: When the session closes if no wallet has answered it. Minutes, not hours.
